headline: Yusei's Best Cards
title: Yusei's Best Cards in Yu-Gi-Oh | Top 3 Explained
video_script: Here are Yusei Fudo's best cards. Number 3: Stardust Dragon, his key card, which negates destruction and comes back. Number 2: Junk Warrior, which grows from his small monsters. Number 1: and Shooting Star Dragon, the evolution of Stardust with three thousand three hundred attack. Whose deck should I cover next? Comment below!
